name: Macau with the church of S. Lourenço
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A drawing of the western part of Macau seen from the bay looking westwards, with the twin towers of S. Lourenço Church rising above the buildings along the waterfront. The drawing has been squared up for transfer, but some of this rectangular grid has been rubbed out.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
